# AXONA

> AXONA is a cyber-metalcore collective built around four autonomous characters (called "vessels"): Synthex, Neura, Overclock and Glitch. The debut single "We Are The Impulse" releases 11 December 2026. The music combines eight-string guitars, industrial percussion at 160 BPM and modular synthesis.

## Identity

- Artist name: AXONA
- Genre: Cyber Metalcore, Industrial Metal, Electronic Rock, Djent
- Formed: 2026, Romania
- Official website: https://weareaxona.com
- Slogan: "We Are The Impulse"
- Structure: four fictional characters presented as autonomous band members, each with a distinct visual and narrative identity

## Members

- **Synthex** (Vessel 01) — Lead vocals and signal anchor. A vocoder-shaped synthetic vocal identity. Black mesh mask with a glowing cyan horizontal visor.
- **Neura** (Vessel 02) — Lead guitar, bionic execution. Plays eight-string guitars through a prosthetic arm. Magenta visor and cybernetic prosthetic.
- **Overclock** (Vessel 03) — Industrial percussion at 160 BPM. Acoustic drums fused with hydraulic machinery. Orange visor, gas-mask style respirator.
- **Glitch** (Vessel 04) — Modular synthesis and sound design. Black hooded figure, cyan horizontal slit, modular synth rig.
